mentions.description: A personal AI librarian that makes large collections of local epub and pdf files accessible again. It helps users rediscover forgotten files, find information by meaning, explore unexpected connections, and save discoveries for future interests or projects.
mentions.problem: Large collections of local epub and pdf files become forgotten and hard to access; it is difficult to find information by meaning or explore connections across the collection.
mentions.audience: People with large personal collections of local epub and pdf files who want to rediscover and search them.
mentions.author: markcheno
